segments.summary: one-frame poster: the settled headline + 16-logo ring layout of S03 (identical to f181)

6 empty frames, then a honeycomb of hex mascot cells fills the frame from one cell on a constant-speed radial front (19.6 px/f, each cell a 7-frame fade + scale pop); every cell glances once at a random time, the glances trailing the fill out to the frame edges until f94 (no still hold); from f95 the field wraps into a globe and collapses to a point (T02)

centred 4-word headline built by single-frame word pops (8-9 f/word) inside a 2:1 elliptical ring of 16 logo icons that pop in as opposite pairs in a clockwise sweep and orbit clockwise at a constant 0.3565 deg/f; headline cut out at f225, ring at f226

large hex mascot pops in at the centre (scale 0.32 -> 1, ease-out), glances three times with eye squash, blinks once, then slides 33% W left and shrinks to 0.40 (ease-in-out) as a one-word lockup pops in beside it
text card: one centred 3-word line built by single-frame word pops (7 f/word), static
text card: one centred 6-word line built by single-frame word pops (5-6 f/word), static
small headline at the top (word pops, 6 f/word) over a product UI dialog (search pill + 6-row list) that slowly pushes in 3.5% about its own centre from the cut frame (ease-out); headline fixed
headline (word pops) above a chat input pill that pushes in 2.0%; a prompt is typed character by character (no caret) and the send icon switches at the first character; cut while typing
full-bleed three-column agent-app UI pushing in 5.0% about the frame centre within 57 frames; stepped UI micro-animations: avatar blink and glances, status-label shimmer, pulsing status mascot
text card: one centred 3-word line built by single-frame word pops (7-8 f/word), static
team-chat window (dark sidebar, white pane) pushing in 3.0% about the frame centre while four messages rise 9-13 px and fade in, one every 25-26 frames (25.2 f cadence)
one centred big headline line (3 words) built by one-frame word pops at its final layout (f901, f909, f916), then held still

code-repository panel (pull-request list) slowly pushing in 3.0% from the cut; 3 pinned cards then 4 list rows fade in with a 6-7 px rise every 11.3 f, and one beat after each item its status pill swaps state with a shrink-out / scale-pop-in

small top headline word pops; 9 agent logo icons in two centred rows (4 + 5) pop in (fade + scale from 0.5) every 3.6 f in reading order; from f1161 (sub-pixel, 1 px at f1162) they converge into a mascot row (T14)
row of 6 hex mascots (one black) under a big centred headline built by 6 f word pops; the mascots glance down-left as a left-to-right wave, glance back together and fly off into the next layout (T15)

app sidebar panel with mascot avatars pushing in 4% about (959, 449) under a screen-fixed bottom caption built by 6 f word pops; three eye-glance waves run from the tile logo down the 5 avatars (look down-left f1247, right f1277, up f1319), each faster than the last (4.2, 3.0, 1.8 f per step), and the avatars blink in pairs between waves 2 and 3
one centred big headline line (3 words) by one-frame word pops (8, 7 f), held

after one empty frame, 30 hex mascots of 4 tones pop in at random spots around a big 2-word headline, one every 1.5 f; from f1432, while the births still run, each mascot glances once (19-43 f after its own birth) and three of them blink
article web page (label pill, title, paragraph, scatter chart) under a small top caption built by word pops; the whole page scrolls up 560 px in 21 f, holds, then scroll-pushes out (T19)

hub-and-spoke network (black mascot hub, 4 laptop and 4 cloud outline icons, each on a canvas-coloured box) settles from the scroll-push; one packet per connector ping-pongs on a 42 f period shared by all lines, at the constant speed its line length gives (11.3-23.0 px/f), hidden where it passes under the hub or an icon's box; a small top headline pops in word by word while the hub glances left, right and back
after 3 empty frames a 2-line centred big headline (3 + 5 words) is built by one-frame word pops at 6-7 f, then held 63 f

end card: after one empty frame the hex mascot logo scales in, straightens a 17 deg tilt and fades in on one ease-out; a URL label fades in below; the logo glances, blinks and glances back; static to the last frame
